forceDescription.transcribe: Deletes all speaker segments, utterances, and summaries for this meeting, then re-transcribes from scratch.
forceDescription.processAgenda: Deletes all subjects and auto-generated highlights for this meeting, then re-processes the agenda from scratch. User-created highlights are preserved (unlinked from subjects).
forceDescription.summarize: Agenda subjects are kept and updated; non-agenda subjects are replaced. Deletes topic labels and resets utterance discussion tracking (status and subject links).

panel.adaTitle: Add a decision by ADA for {subject}
panel.adaHint: The ADA is the code of the posting on Diavgeia, e.g. ΨΞΚ1ΩΗΔ-Α1Β. We will find the decision, the number and the vote result ourselves.
panel.linkHint: Type the number from the minutes. Below are the Diavgeia decisions for this meeting that have no subject yet, with the most likely one first.
panel.changeHint: Choose the decision that belongs here. {number} returns to the decisions without a subject and is not lost.
panel.noResults: No decision with number {query} among the ones we found for this meeting. If it was just published, we will find it at the next check. If you have it in front of you, add it with its ADA.
panel.saveFailed: The link did not save. Nothing changed.
panel.replaceHalfDone: {number} was removed, but the new link was not saved. The subject is left without a decision — link one again from the table.
panel.replaceNote: {number} returns to the decisions without a subject.
panel.replaceNoteDestructive: {number} was added by hand: it is deleted for good, along with its attendance and its votes.
panel.moveNote: It leaves {from}, which stays without a decision, and links to {subject}.
panel.unlinkNote: {subject} stays without a decision. {number} returns to the decisions without a subject and is not lost.
panel.unlinkNoteDestructive: {number} was added by hand. There is no Diavgeia record to return to: it is deleted for good, along with its attendance and its votes.
